subject: Request: admin log extracts for SIG review — timebox & redaction plan
messages:
From: Claire Johns <claire.johns@medicosys.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: sig-requests@medicosys.com, Compliance Team <compliance@medicosys.com>
Date: Sun, 26 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: admin log extracts for SIG review — timebox & redaction plan

Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week. MedicoSys's SIG evaluation team needs a short, timeboxed admin activity extract to validate logging coverage for our SOC 2 / SIG review. Our ask is: a 7‑day slice of admin events covering (1) role changes, (2) privileged actions, (3) model deploys/rollbacks, and (4) console session start/stop.

Priority items for us: timestamps in UTC, user principal (email), action_type, target_resource, request_id, and any correlated agent (API key / service account). We also need a brief description of any PII redaction rules you apply. Ideally we get an encrypted bundle we can verify within our secure intake pipeline; a signed manifest of checksums would be great.

Timeline: can you provide a delivery estimate? We have a SIG window scheduled on Aug 3 and would like the material at least 48 hours prior (Aug 1).

Thanks — feel free to loop anyone internal who can help with export/redaction.

Claire
Claire Johns
Sr. Security Analyst — MedicoSys
claire.johns@medicosys.com

---
Attachment: sig-sample-fields.pdf (stub: one‑page list of requested fields)

From: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
To: Claire Johns <claire.johns@medicosys.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin log extracts for SIG review — timebox & redaction plan

Claire — thanks for the clear ask. Looping Kimberley (engineering lead, exports) and Marissa (compliance lead) to confirm format and redaction. Ben from solutions will coordinate handoff logistics.

Short answers up front: yes, we can produce a 7‑day timebox, signed manifest, and a list of applied redaction rules. We typically include UTC timestamps and request_id. Small caveat: API key identifiers are hashed for tenant privacy — we can provide deterministic keyed hashes and note the salt for verification in the manifest if that works for you.

Next steps I propose:
- Kimberley to confirm export formats and expected S3/GDrive delivery APIs.
- Marissa to outline redaction policy and provide a short attestation note.
- Ben to propose a secure transfer window; options: presigned S3 + PGP‑wrapped bundle, or an encrypted transfer to your intake SFTP.

Target timetable: internal extraction + review by Jul 29, bundle to you Jul 30 (gives you 48 hours before Aug 1). Can you confirm intake preference (S3 or SFTP) and whether you require IP allowlisting?

Rafael
Director, Security & Compliance Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Claire Johns <claire.johns@medicosys.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin log extracts for SIG review — timebox & redaction plan

Claire / team — hi, Kimberly here. Quick technical note on export options and the bundle shape so you can validate against your intake. Details below; happy to jump on a 30‑minute call if you want to walk through the manifest.

Export formats we can produce (pick one):
- Flattened CSV (utf‑8) with header row and column list: utc_ts, tenant_id, user_email, action_type, target_resource, request_id, request_path, http_status, proto_agent, hashed_api_key, session_id, kv_delta_summary
- NDJSON (newline JSON) — same fields, one object per event (better for large volumes)

Redaction rules we will apply by default for SIG handoffs:
- Full replacement for raw request bodies (we never include raw payloads).
- Email addresses retained only for login principals (user_email) but hashed for non‑interactive service principals.
- API keys and tokens replaced with HMAC‑sha256(salt + key) using a customer‑scoped salt; salt included in signed manifest for verification.
- IP addresses: we can provide either full IPs or truncated (/24) depending on your privacy needs — confirm preference.

Sampling & scope options (choose one):
- Full 7‑day slice (recommended) — small customers: typically <2GB; enterprise workloads can be larger.
- Deterministic sampling — 1 in N events per action_type with head/tail preservation for deploy/rollback sequences.
- Event aggregation — for very large tenants we can provide per‑action summaries plus a 72‑hour raw window around any flagged deploys.

Manifest & attestation: we produce a signed manifest (Ed25519) that includes checksums (SHA‑256) of each file, the salt used for keyed hashes, export parameters, and a short redaction declaration. We can also timestamp the manifest with our Artifact Service for non‑repudiation.

Delivery options we support:
- Presigned S3 HTTPS PUT (recommended) + PGP envelope for files. We will coordinate one‑time credentials and object keys.
- Managed SFTP drop with SFTP user created for MedicoSys and IP allowlist.
- Encrypted Google Drive upload to your intake folder (less preferred for attestation workflows).

Proposed schedule:
- Jul 29: internal extraction + redaction + manifest generation
- Jul 30 (AM): PGP‑wrapped bundle delivered to MedicoSys S3/SFTP
- Jul 30 (PM): RFC email with manifest and verification steps; one hour window for immediate validation; we hold the bundle for 48 hours for any checksum challenges

Attachments: redwood-log-sample-2026-07.csv (sample of CSV export), export-manifest-template.xlsx, redaction-rules.md

If that plan works, Rafael / Ben — please proceed and I'll start the extraction job tonight. Claire — please confirm (1) S3 vs SFTP, (2) IP allowlisting requirement, and (3) whether you want full IPs or truncated.

-Kimberly
Engineering Lead, Exports
Redwood Inference

---

From: Claire Johns <claire.johns@medicosys.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, sig-requests@medicosys.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin log extracts for SIG review — timebox & redaction plan

Kimberly — thanks, that level of detail is perfect. We confirm:
- Delivery: Presigned S3 PUT into our intake bucket (we will provide bucket path and allowlist).
- IP allowlist: yes, we will share the CIDR blocks for the transfer window.
- IPs: truncated /24 is fine for the review.
- Sampling: full 7‑day slice preferred.

Two small asks:
1) Could you include one example row with the original and redacted forms side‑by‑side in the manifest (fake redacted example acceptable) so our intake engineers can validate the mapping?
2) Please include timezone normalization note — we require UTC timestamps and an explicit "timestamp_source" field (server_received | client_emitted).

If you can deliver Jul 30 AM as proposed we are good. Once we receive the bundle our intake team will run the checksum verification and ping you within the 2‑hour validation window if anything looks off.

Thanks everyone — look forward to reviewing.

Claire
Sr. Security Analyst — MedicoSys
